'''Stun tube''' was a small, short-range [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] used to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] targets. The weapon carried one charge and was effective for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Stun tube first appeared in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
